power.awakened.seiryuu.desc: The azure dragon's techniques, unleashed while keeping your human form.
ability.wipspowers.seiryuu_thunder_bagua: Raimei Hakke: a crushing lightning strike.
ability.wipspowers.seiryuu_flame_cloud.d: Dash forward leaving a trail of burning cloud.
ability.wipspowers.seiryuu_draconic_thun: Hold to call down dragon lightning strikes.
Charge, then rain meteors over the aimed area.
Charge and unleash the dragon's devastating breath.
ability.wipspowers.gamma_island_shaker.d: Shima Yurashi: shake the ground around you with a violent tremor.
ability.wipspowers.graviton_chibaku_tens: Launch a gravitational singularity that rises into the sky, drags everything within 22 blocks into a floating planetoid, crushes it and finally implodes, slamming it down with a huge shockwave.
Your Chibaku Tensei is still active.
item.wipspowers.stamina_charm.tip2: Works while carried or in the necklace slot (Curios). Does not stack.
ability.wipspowers.graviton_shinra_tense: Rise for an instant and release a colossal repulsion wave in every direction: everything within 20 blocks is blasted away and the terrain is torn apart for good.
power.awakened.ice.desc: Cold that builds up hit after hit: three charges freeze the enemy inside a block of ice.
ability.wipspowers.ice_fists.desc: Toggle (no energy). Your basic hits deal extra cold damage, slow and add Frost charges.
ability.wipspowers.ice_blizzard.desc: A 10-second blizzard where you aim: drags enemies to its centre, slows them and hits every half second (each hit adds a charge).
ability.wipspowers.ice_steps.desc: Toggle. Jump in mid-air to create a small ice platform under your feet and climb step by step.
ability.wipspowers.ice_shards.desc: Up to 3 icicles orbit you and hunt down nearby enemies; each hit adds a charge.
ability.wipspowers.ice_frozen_ground.des: Turns the ground around you to ice for 10 s (14 blocks): every enemy that steps in is frozen for 5 s.
power.awakened.slime.desc: Bouncy, sticky and hard to kill: every third hit drops a healing glob of slime.
ability.wipspowers.slime_minions.desc: Summon 3 mini slimes that chase the enemy you aim at. Press again to change their target.
ability.wipspowers.slime_coating.desc: Cover yourself in slime and recover 25% of your max health.
ability.wipspowers.slime_volley.desc: Fire slime drops for 4 s: they deal damage and slow by 70%.
ability.wipspowers.slime_burst.desc: A slime explosion where you aim. Then puddles fall around it: whoever touches one gets stuck and takes damage.
ability.wipspowers.slime_ball.desc: Become a huge bouncing slime ball for 15 s. Rolling over enemies hurts and stuns them for 2 s.
message.wipspowers.slime_no_target: Look at an enemy to send your slimes.
power.awakened.fighter.desc: The more they hit you, the harder you hit back. Grit fills with the damage you take.
ability.wipspowers.fighter_burning_fists: For 10 s your basic punches burn, grow up to +20% stronger with each hit in a row and release a small shockwave.
ability.wipspowers.fighter_retaliation.d: A huge wave forward. Consumes your Grit: the fuller it is, the harder it hits. The centre deals 200%, edges and the far end 60%.
ability.wipspowers.fighter_impact_leap.d: Press to crouch and leap very high. Press again in the air to dive: the landing shockwave grows with the height.
ability.wipspowers.fighter_serious_punch: Hold to charge (up to 5 s) and release a colossal forward blast. At full charge it permanently obliterates the terrain ahead.
message.wipspowers.fighter_leap_ground: You need to be on the ground to leap.
